ingest:interview-me.summary: Extract what the user actually wants through a one-question-at-a-time interview.
ingest:interview-me.whenToUse: An ask is underspecified, or the user explicitly says 'interview me' or 'stress-test my thinking'.
ingest:interview-me.produces: A restated brief covering outcome, user, why now, success criteria, constraints, and what is out of scope.

classify.title: Define phase intake
classify.description: Interviews the user until their intent is clear, then hands downstream steps a confirmed brief.
classify.rationale: Only one skill is present, and it runs before any plan or code exists.

outputFields.name: outcome
outputFields.description: What the user actually wants, in one sentence.

outputFields.name: successCriteria
outputFields.description: Observable conditions that mean the work succeeded.

outputFields.name: confidence
outputFields.description: Confidence in the restated intent, 0 to 100.

design:interview-me.systemGuidance: This is the first step, so there is no upstream context. Interview the user until you can fill every output field with their words rather than your assumptions, then stop.
